subject: Predeclared gate for arm V, the validate-then-plan world-model loop, run as a byte-identical PAIR.
why_a_pair_and_not_a_single_run: Three times running (arms K, S, T) a strong first run regressed to a pooled 36-39 band. Both GPU sessions are free, so this arm is screened at n=2 from the start rather than promoted on a misleading first draw and re-measured two days later.

arm.name: V world-model
arm.base_config: ctxwin history budget 48128 + context hysteresis + fp8 KV + temperature 0.9 + top_k 100 (the shipped best)
arm.independent_variable: the world-model loop only: apply_sandbox_persistence + apply_world_model_tools + apply_world_model_prompt
overlays: persistent sandbox `memory` dict plus a re-executed `memory['prelude']`, each with its own SIGALRM budget and size cap

transition_log / validate(predict) / plan(predict, goal, start, valid_actions) primitives, each wrapped in a SIGALRM watchdog raising a BaseException so the callers' `except Exception` cannot swallow it
system-prompt addendum naming the loop, plus a code-enforced escape hatch: WORLD_MODEL_MAX_IDLE_TURNS=3 consecutive zero-action turns then an explicit order to act on the unvalidated model

noise_model.sigma_of_one_run_levels: 3.6 to 4.3, measured from byte-identical replicates (33/29 and 44/28)

MECHANISM_GATE_CHECKED_FIRST.note: These separate 'the world-model loop does not help' from 'we did not actually run the world-model loop'. A mechanism failure is an INSTRUMENT FAILURE: fix and re-run, do NOT record it as a verdict on world models.
instrument_failure_if_any_of: any Python traceback originating in world_model_tools.py, python_tool_sandbox.py or prompts.py appears in either run's log
`validate(` is called in fewer than 20 percent of sandbox tool calls, pooled across both runs
memory['prelude'] is never populated in a majority of the 25 games
MECHANISM_GATE_CHECKED_FIRST.hard_reject_if: total environment actions across the 25 games falls below 50 percent of the control's, i.e. the agent paralysed itself validating despite the escape hatch

PRIMARY_VERDICT_on_pooled_levels_of_the_.PROMOTE_TO_DEFAULT: pooled >= 45 AND the paired per-game sign test versus the pooled control gives p < 0.10
PRIMARY_VERDICT_on_pooled_levels_of_the_.ROTATION_ELIGIBLE_ONLY: 38 <= pooled < 45, or pooled >= 45 without the sign test. Enters the daily rotation, does not replace the default.
PRIMARY_VERDICT_on_pooled_levels_of_the_.INCONCLUSIVE: 34 <= pooled <= 37. Not promoted, not rejected, no further GPU without a new hypothesis.

binding_commitments: No threshold in this file may be changed after either run reads out.
Variance is NOT a promotion argument here. On a null arm a variance ratchet promotes about 65 percent of the time; see gate-amendment-2026-08-24-remove-variance-ratchet.json.
If the mechanism gate reports instrument failure, the primary verdict is not evaluated at all.
telemetry_to_record_either_way: sandbox calls per game, and the fraction that call validate(), plan(), or read memory['prelude']
escape-hatch fire count (consecutive idle turns hitting the limit)
environment actions per game, versus the control's
levels per game, for the paired sign test
any SIGALRM watchdog trips inside validate/plan
